robots_txt.summary: data.fca.org.uk serves a Cloudflare-managed robots.txt with Content-Signals: search=yes, ai-train=no, ai-input/use=reference, plus explicit Disallow: / blocks for named AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and others), stated as an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790. Separately, www.fca.org.uk/robots.txt is a Drupal robots.txt that disallows /*? (any URL with a query string), /search/, /admin/, /user/*, /core/, /profiles/, /node/add/ etc., and allows SiteimproveBot. Note: the NSM search UI is query-string driven, so most NSM result URLs fall under the /*? disallow pattern on the www host.

clause_verbatim: Users will not ... use nor attempt to use any 'scraper,' 'robot,' 'bot,' 'spider,' 'data mining,' 'computer code,' or any other automated device ... to access, acquire, copy, or monitor any portion of the website ... without the prior written consent of the FCA
clause_english_gloss: FCA website terms (clause 4.8, prohibited activities) ban scrapers, robots, bots, spiders and data-mining code from accessing or copying any part of the site without FCA's prior written consent. Source is already in English; ellipses mark text elided by the page extractor, not by paraphrase.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Restricted. Terms permit printing/downloading extracts 'on the following conditions' limited to personal or internal organisational use, and state such extracts 'must not ... be distributed, sold or otherwise circulated to third parties'. Additionally: 'You must not use data from this site to provide a data feed to any comparison table or any other website without our written permission.' The Open Government Licence v3.0 is referenced only narrowly - for FCA Handbook content ('Content from the FCA Handbook can be reproduced and adapted in accordance with the Open Government Licence v3.0') and for 'Some statistical outputs published jointly by the FCA and the Bank of England and/or the Prudential Regulation Authority'. No OGL statement was found covering NSM filings; the NSM documents themselves are issuer copyright, not Crown/FCA copyright, so OGL could not apply to them in any event.
practical_notes: Clear, explicit anti-scraping clause plus AI-crawler blocks at the data.fca.org.uk host. This is the strongest single prohibition in the European set. Bulk NSM harvesting would require prior written FCA consent; the FCA has historically discussed NSM data access separately. There is no public NSM API. Requesting written permission is the only compliant route.

site: London Stock Exchange - RNS news portal (LSEG)

robots_txt.summary: User-agent: * with Disallow: /en-gb/, /lsecws/, /LSECWS/, and two Sparklive transition announcement pages; Sitemap: https://www.londonstockexchange.com/sitemap.xml. The /news and RNS announcement paths are NOT disallowed by robots.txt - the restriction lives entirely in the site terms.

clause_verbatim: You are not permitted to use any programmatic, scripted or other mechanical means to access this Website or the Information on this Website.
clause_english_gloss: Direct ban on any programmatic, scripted or mechanical (i.e. non-human-browser) access to the site or its content. Source is already in English.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Prohibited without permission. The disclaimer states the Information 'may not be copied, reproduced, republished, downloaded, posted, broadcast or transmitted in any other way to any third parties for commercial gain.' The parent LSEG Website Terms of Use, section 10 (Restrictions on Use), adds: 'You agree not to use, or attempt to use, any bot, script, automation software, or other automated tool or process to access, interact with, or perform any function on this Website' - expressly extended to search and bulk content downloading, and applying regardless of whether the purpose is internal, commercial or personal.
practical_notes: Two independent prohibitions (site disclaimer + LSEG group terms). robots.txt permissiveness is irrelevant here. RNS content is commercially licensed by LSEG; the compliant route is an RNS/LSEG data licence, not scraping. Treat as a hard no-go.

robots_txt.summary: Allow: / with targeted Disallow entries for transactional and personalised paths in all five UI languages (de/en/fr/it/es): publication/Veroeffentlichung, registerPortal/user registration, document cart (Dokumentenkorb / panier-de-documents / cesta-de-documentos), checkout and deposit/payment areas, error pages, and /redirect/*. Five language sitemaps are declared. Public search/result pages are not blanket-disallowed.

clause_verbatim: Das Unternehmensregister genießt Datenbankschutz nach § 87a ff. UrhG und darf insoweit nicht ohne Zustimmung des Verlags außerhalb der gesetzlichen Vorschriften genutzt werden.
clause_english_gloss: The Unternehmensregister enjoys database protection under sections 87a ff. of the German Copyright Act (sui generis database right) and, to that extent, may not be used outside the statutory provisions without the publisher's consent.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Governed by the sui generis database right rather than an express scraping clause. The Allgemeine Nutzungsbedingungen (D061 / Bundesanzeiger D088) permit copying of retrieved data by the user: 'Daten können vom Nutzer durch Ausdruck oder als elektronische Datei kopiert werden' (users may copy data by printing or as an electronic file), but section 7(3) prohibits building a competing register: 'Der Nutzer verpflichtet sich, die abgerufenen Daten ... nicht für den Aufbau oder die Unterhaltung eines eigenen Registers parallel zum Handelsregister zu verwenden' (the user undertakes not to use retrieved data to build or maintain their own register parallel to the commercial register). No express permission for commercial redistribution.
practical_notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the brief: across the Impressum, the /de/rechtliches page and the Nutzungsbedingungen PDFs actually readable, I found NO clause expressly banning 'automatisierter Abruf' / Crawler / Roboter, and the only 'ganz oder teilweise' wording located (D061 section 13(3)(b), D088) concerns the irrevocability of publication orders, not reproduction. The operative restriction is the section 87a UrhG database right plus the anti-parallel-register covenant. Retrieving individual documents for internal M&A research is defensible; systematic extraction of a substantial part of the database would infringe the database right without publisher consent. Practically, the portal also applies CAPTCHA and session throttling that make scaled automated retrieval unreliable. Legal sign-off by German counsel recommended before any bulk pull.

robots_txt.summary: User-agent: * with Disallow: /nlp and Disallow: /construction_page.html only. AhrefsBot and MJ12bot are given Disallow: / (full block). Publication and search paths are not disallowed for general crawlers.

clause_verbatim: Der Bundesanzeiger genießt Datenbankschutz nach §§ 87a ff. UrhG und darf insoweit nicht ohne Zustimmung des Verlags außerhalb der gesetzlichen Vorschriften genutzt werden.
clause_english_gloss: The Bundesanzeiger enjoys database protection under sections 87a ff. of the German Copyright Act and, to that extent, may not be used outside the statutory provisions without the publisher's consent.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Not expressly permitted. The Impressum asserts the sui generis database right and conditions any use beyond the statutory exceptions on Bundesanzeiger Verlag's consent. The /pub/de/rechtliches page is a directory of ~15 service-specific AGB PDFs (D042 publications, D089 annual accounts, D065 investment funds, D073 short selling, D088 corporate register, etc.); these govern paid publication services rather than granting readers redistribution rights.
practical_notes: Same posture as Unternehmensregister (same publisher). I did not find the specific 'ganz oder teilweise' reproduction ban or an express automated-retrieval prohibition in the HTML terms pages readable to me - reported honestly rather than asserted. The binding constraint is the section 87a UrhG database right. In practice Bundesanzeiger applies CAPTCHA and session/IP throttling, and there is no free official API, so scaled automated retrieval is technically obstructed even where not contractually named. Confirm with German counsel; the safer route is a commercial data licence from Bundesanzeiger Verlag or a licensed reseller.

robots_txt.summary: HTTP 404 on both https://www.1info.it/robots.txt and https://1info.it/robots.txt - no robots.txt is served. No crawl directives exist; absence of robots.txt is not permission.

clause_verbatim: La riproduzione delle informazioni rilevanti (comunicati e documenti) contenute all'interno del sito www.1info.it, con qualsiasi mezzo analogico o digitale, non è consentita senza l'esplicita autorizzazione di Computershare.
clause_english_gloss: Reproduction of the regulated information (announcements and documents) held on www.1info.it, by any analogue or digital means, is not permitted without Computershare's explicit authorisation.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Prohibited without written consent. The notice bars reproduction 'con qualsiasi mezzo analogico o digitale' without explicit Computershare authorisation; reproduction for public or commercial purposes requires written consent, with only personal, non-commercial use permitted.
practical_notes: No dedicated 'Note legali' / 'Termini e condizioni' page was reachable (https://www.1info.it/it/note-legali returns 404); the operative text is the copyright/legal notice rendered on the single-page site, which is a JS-driven SPA. There is no clause naming scraping, crawler or automated access specifically - the prohibition bites through 'riproduzione ... con qualsiasi mezzo ... digitale', which on its face covers automated copying. Storing scraped documents would be reproduction. Compliant route: request authorisation from Computershare (storage@1info.it).

robots_txt.summary: Standard Drupal robots.txt: Allow rules for CSS/JS/image assets under /core/ and /profiles/; Disallow /core/, /profiles/, /README.txt, /web.config, /admin/, /comment/reply/, /filter/tips, /node/add/, /search/, /user/register, /user/password, /user/login, /user/logout and their /index.php/ equivalents. Note /search/ is disallowed, which covers the site's own search endpoint. No AI-crawler blocks.

clause_verbatim: I Contenuti possono essere utilizzati solo per uso personale (ad esempio, per motivi di studio e di ricerca) e per uso non commerciale. La riproduzione, la modifica, la distribuzione, la trasmissione, la ripubblicazione, la visualizzazione o le prestazioni dei Contenuti sono severamente vietate.
clause_english_gloss: The Contents may be used only for personal use (for example, for study and research purposes) and for non-commercial use. Reproduction, modification, distribution, transmission, republication, display or performance of the Contents is strictly forbidden.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Expressly prohibited. Use is confined to personal, non-commercial purposes; any reproduction of the Contents or part of them requires Teleborsa's prior explicit consent ('I Contenuti, o parte di essi, possono essere riprodotti solo con il consenso preliminare ed esplicito di Teleborsa S.r.l.'). The site footer also carries: 'Nessun materiale di questo sito può essere pubblicato, distribuito, venduto o riprodotto in nessuna forma, sia stampata che scritta, senza l'autorizzazione di Teleborsa S.r.l.'
practical_notes: The non-commercial restriction is the decisive one for JCAI: M&A deal sourcing is commercial use, so even personal-style reading is outside the licence. No clause names scraping or automated access explicitly, but the reproduction ban covers automated copying. Contact infoSDIR@teleborsa.it for authorisation. robots.txt disallows /search/, so automated querying of the search endpoint also runs against the technical signal.

site: CNMV - Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (hechos relevantes / OIR / OPAs)

robots_txt.summary: Last updated 24/06/2025. User-agent: * with a single directive Disallow: *.shtml. Two sitemaps declared (sitemap.xml and sitemap_entidades.xml). Effectively permissive - registers, hechos relevantes and OPA pages are not disallowed.

clause_verbatim: Los usuarios del sitio Web de la Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores podrán hacer libre uso privado de la información obtenida directamente de ella, incluso la realización de copias en memoria local (RAM) u otros dispositivos de almacenamiento temporal. La distribución o reproducción de la información que se difunde en el sitio Web de la Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores debe ser realizada fielmente, sin manipular ni alterar los contenidos.
clause_english_gloss: Users of the CNMV website may make free private use of information obtained directly from it, including copies in local memory (RAM) or other temporary storage. Distribution or reproduction of information disseminated on the CNMV website must be done faithfully, without manipulating or altering the contents.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Permitted subject to conditions - the most permissive national regulator in this set. Onward distribution and reproduction are contemplated and allowed provided the content is reproduced faithfully and unaltered. Where information is sold or assigned, the Nota Legal requires that 'la persona física o jurídica que la publique o difunda bajo cualquier soporte, deberá informar a los compradores y/o cesionarios, que la información puede ser obtenida libre de cargo a través del sitio Web' - i.e. buyers must be told the information is available free from the CNMV site. Derived calculations may be disseminated: 'La información ... se podrá utilizar para realizar cálculos que se difundan por el usuario'. CNMV retains IP in texts, photos and graphic elements: 'son titularidad exclusiva del Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores, que ostenta todos los derechos de explotación'.
practical_notes: The Nota Legal was reachable only at sede.cnmv.gob.es; https://www.cnmv.es/portal/AvisoLegal.aspx returned HTTP 403 and the current portal routes to a 'Legal note' at /portal/Utilidades/NotaLegal.aspx. IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the brief: I found no reference to Ley 37/2007 (public-sector reuse) or to an open-data licence in the Nota Legal text read - the framework cited is Ley 39/2015. There is no clause on robots, scraping, crawlers or automated access. Classified CONDITIONAL rather than SILENT because the terms affirmatively regulate reuse (fidelity + free-availability disclosure) rather than being silent on it. Best European candidate for scraping alongside DG COMP. Rate-limit politely; CNMV also offers downloadable datasets in places.

site: SIX Exchange Regulation (SER) - official notices / ad hoc announcements

robots_txt.summary: User-agent: * with Disallow: /bin, Disallow: /*/shared/component/, Disallow: /dam/downloads/regulation/listing-archive; Allow: /dam, /en, /de, /fr; sitemap at https://www.ser-ag.com/sitemap.xml. Notably the regulation listing-archive download path is disallowed. six-group.com robots.txt is similar (Disallow /bin, /*/shared/component/, /content/_cq_tags, /content/cq:tags, a subscription-preferences path; Allow /dam, /en, /de, /fr, /it, /es, /ja).

clause_verbatim: The reproduction in whole or in part, transmission (by electronic or other means), modification, linking or use of these websites for public or commercial purposes without the prior written consent of SIX is prohibited.
clause_english_gloss: Reproducing the SIX/SER websites in whole or in part, transmitting, modifying, linking or using them for public or commercial purposes requires SIX's prior written consent. Source is already in English (German version also published).
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Prohibited without prior written SIX consent. The whole site is asserted to be copyright-protected and third-party redistribution is restricted absent express written authorisation. Use of the SIX websites 'is governed exclusively by Swiss law.' Issuers bear sole responsibility for prospectus and official-notice content; SIX does not verify it.
practical_notes: No clause names scraping, crawlers, bots or automated access specifically - the prohibition operates through 'reproduction in whole or in part ... for public or commercial purposes'. JCAI's use is commercial, so scraping and storing SER notices falls squarely inside the ban. Note also that robots.txt disallows the regulation listing-archive download directory. Compliant route: request written consent from SIX, or use SIX's commercial data products.

robots_txt.summary: No robots.txt is served: requests to /robots.txt (direct and via the r.jina.ai reader, http and https) return the NewsWeb single-page application HTML rather than a text file. No crawl directives are published for this host. The legacy oslobors.no disclaimer URL now 301-redirects to https://www.euronext.com/en/terms-use.

clause_verbatim: This database is protected by the provisions of the Norwegian Copyright Act (Åndsverkloven) § 43 ... [content] cannot be reproduced outside private use ... except with Oslo Børs' prior written consent. // Euronext Terms of Use: "use of any Web browsers (other than generally available third-party browsers), engines, software, spiders, robots, avatars, agents, tools or other devices or mechanisms to navigate, search or determine the Euronext Website is strictly prohibited"
clause_english_gloss: NewsWeb's own notice asserts sui generis database protection under section 43 of the Norwegian Copyright Act and requires Oslo Børs' prior written consent for any reproduction beyond private use, with 'copying' expressly defined to include downloading and storage on a device. The Euronext group Terms of Use, to which the legacy Oslo Børs disclaimer URL now redirects, strictly prohibit spiders, robots, agents and similar mechanisms for navigating or searching the site. Both sources are in English; the first quote contains ellipses marking text elided by the page extractor.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: Prohibited. Euronext Terms of Use: 'you will not sell, license, rent, modify, print, copy, reproduce, download, upload, transmit, distribute, disseminate, publicly display, publicly perform, publish, edit, adapt, compile or create derivative works from any Content or materials (including, without limitation, through framing or systematic retrieval to create collections, compilations, databases or directories)'. Only a single copy for personal, non-commercial use with proprietary notices intact is permitted. Oslo Børs additionally disclaims all responsibility for errors in the stored information.
practical_notes: Two overlapping prohibitions: the Norwegian database right asserted on NewsWeb itself, and the Euronext group terms banning spiders/robots and 'systematic retrieval to create collections, compilations, databases or directories' - which is a precise description of the harvesting JCAI would do. Absence of a robots.txt is not consent. Compliant route: Euronext market-data licence (LegalNL@euronext.com).

site: European Commission - DG Competition case register

robots_txt.summary: UNVERIFIED. Every attempt (https, http, via the r.jina.ai reader, and with a cache-busting query) returned the Angular single-page-application shell ('Competition case search') instead of a text/plain robots.txt, so the site appears to serve the SPA for unmatched paths. No crawl directives could be read. The wider ec.europa.eu estate does not publish a blanket crawl prohibition.

clause_verbatim: The Commission's reuse policy is implemented by the Commission Decision of 12 December 2011 on the reuse of Commission documents. Unless otherwise indicated (e.g. in individual copyright notices), content owned by the EU on this website is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence.
clause_english_gloss: EU-owned content on Commission websites is by default reusable under CC BY 4.0 - including for commercial purposes - pursuant to Decision 2011/833/EU, subject to attribution and indication of any changes. Source is already in English.
commercial_use_or_redistribution: ALLOWED. CC BY 4.0 expressly permits commercial reuse and redistribution provided attribution is given and modifications are indicated. Two carve-outs are stated: additional rights clearance may be needed where content depicts identifiable individuals or incorporates third-party works, and industrial property rights (patents, trade marks, registered designs, logos, names) are excluded from the reuse policy. Copyright line: '© European Union, 1995-2026'.
practical_notes: The clearest ALLOWS in the European set and the only one backed by an open licence. Merger decisions, notifications and Official Journal notices in the case register are Commission documents and fall under the default CC BY 4.0 grant unless a case document carries its own notice. Caveat: some case-file documents are third-party (parties' submissions, non-confidential versions prepared by undertakings) and may carry separate notices - check per document. Also note the case register itself is an SPA with a documented browse cap (only the first 3,000 of ~73,000 results are paginable), so harvesting needs faceted queries rather than a flat crawl. Attribute as required by CC BY 4.0. Crawl politely - robots.txt could not be verified.
